ConnectionStrings.//: Local SQL Server, Windows authentication. No password here to protect, which is why this sits in appsettings rather than user secrets. When per-service SQL logins are introduced (ROADMAP Phase 3) these move to user secrets.

Parameters.//: Local development signing key only. Any service holding this can also mint tokens, which is why production uses asymmetric keys and a JWKS endpoint instead (ADR 0005).
